## Description

Full trial load into an isolated test tenant; report: patient counts, duplicates found, records missing EID/ABHA, values failing checks, mapping coverage, sample comparisons. The owner signs the report in-app before any production load. Re-runnable any number of times.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Production load is impossible until a dry-run report for the same mapping version is signed by the owner (exit gate 2).
- [ ] **AC2.** Re-running the dry run is idempotent and produces a comparable report with deltas.
- [ ] **AC3.** The report is exportable as PDF and stored with hash.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
